text:
Jun Park: Heads up — when previewing the runtime-tuning KB in staging I hit a 403 on the image at s3://redwood-internal/runtime-diagrams/kv-cache.png. Looks like the object is private. Anyone owning that page?
Ava Li: @Jun Park I can take a look, which page exactly? quick link pls
Jun Park: /docs/runtime/serving/kv-cache.md — image link is the S3 path in the markdown. Preview shows the broken thumbnail.
docs-bot: Automated scan: docs-scan detected 403 for asset s3://redwood-internal/runtime-diagrams/kv-cache.png (page: /docs/runtime/serving/kv-cache.md). Suggested action: rehost to CDN or update ACL.
Ava Li: ok. If it's a small asset we can rehost to our CDN bucket and update the md. I can open a quick PR unless this is gated.
Samir Patel: rehost is fine. FYI we prefer CDN-hosted images under /cdn-assets/runtime so it survives deploys and staging previews.
Priya Nair: Also add an author in frontmatter so ownership is tracked: `owner: eng-runtime` — avoids orphaning.
Ava Li: plan: I will download s3 object, push to cdn bucket, update link and frontmatter. Who should review?
Jun Park: ping @Samir for review on the PR for linking + ACL note. I can verify the staging preview after merge.
Samir Patel: happy to review. quick checklist: update alt text, add owner frontmatter line, and add a tiny caption that mentions where the original came from.
Ava Li: making PR now. small sed I used locally to replace S3 path:
```bash
# replace absolute s3 with cdn prefix
sed -i "s|s3://redwood-internal/runtime-diagrams/kv-cache.png|https://cdn.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache.png|g" docs/runtime/serving/kv-cache.md
```
Ava Li: PR: #4821 opened (branch: docs/rehost-kv-cache-4821). Added frontmatter `owner: eng-runtime` and updated alt text.
Samir Patel: looking... small nit: can you also run `markdown-link-check` in CI locally? we've seen other images still 403 when path mismatches.
Ava Li: ran link-check, passes locally. Added a short note in PR description about original S3 path.
Priya Nair: LGTM on ownership. After merge, Jun can confirm staging preview then I will add the redirect rule so old shortlinks map to the new CDN URL (edge redirect).
Jun Park: will confirm staging after merge. If anything still 403 I'll post here with logs.
Ava Li: merged the PR. Deploy should pick up in the next staging build (~5-10m). :shipit:
Jun Park: preview shows image now, staging ok. thanks everyone.
Samir Patel: nice, thanks Ava. I'll add a tiny follow-up task on the backlog to inventory other runtime images referencing s3 buckets.
Priya Nair: noted — I can add the backlog ticket and assign triage.
Jun Park: closing this thread — all good for now. :thumbsup:
